```lean
ContDiff.{u, uE, uF} (𝕜 : Type u) [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
  {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (n : ℕ∞) (f : E → F) : Prop
```
***
A function is continuously differentiable up to `n` if it admits derivatives up to
order `n`, which are continuous. Contrary to the case of definitions in domains (where derivatives
might not be unique) we do not need to localize the definition in space or time.

***
*import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Defs*

```lean
ContinuousAffineMap.decomp.{u_2, u_3, u_4} {R : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedField R] [NormedSpace R V] [NormedSpace R W] (f : V →ᴬ[R] W) :
  ⇑f = ⇑f.contLinear + Function.const V (f 0)
```

  {Q : Type u_7} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [MetricSpace Q]

***
The linear map underlying a continuous affine map is continuous.

*import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Basic*

```lean
ContDiff.add.{uE, uF, u_1} {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : ℕ∞} {f g : E → F} (hf : ContDiff 𝕜 n f)
  (hg : ContDiff 𝕜 n g) : ContDiff 𝕜 n fun x => f x + g x
```
***
The sum of two `C^n`functions is `C^n`. 
***
*import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Basic*

```lean
contDiff_const.{uE, uF, u_1} {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : ℕ∞} {c : F} : ContDiff 𝕜 n fun x => c
```
***
Constants are `C^∞`.

```lean

  [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace 𝕜 V] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace 𝕜 W] {n : ℕ∞} (f : V →ᴬ[𝕜] W) :
  ContDiff 𝕜 n ⇑f
```
***
A continuous affine map between normed vector spaces is smooth.
